skills.name: Basic Attack: Full Firepower
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold to enter Crouching Shot to extend the attack duration.
Drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} during Crouching Shot to launch Rolling Shot and adjust the character's position, dealing Physical DMG.
Stop pressing or holding during Crouching Shot to launch Finishing Shot at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Special Attack: Stand Still
skills.description:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Performs up to 3 piercing attacks in a line, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Clearance Time
skills.description:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a powerful piercing attack in a line, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dodge: Risky Business
skills.description:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Starlight Sanction
skills.description:
When dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} during a dodge, press [Basic Attack]:
Launches a piercing attack at nearby enemies within a large area, dealing Physical DMG.
When not dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} during a dodge, press [Basic Attack]:
Launches a piercing attack at enemies in a line, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Fair Fight
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Starlight Mirage
skills.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful piercing attack at surrounding enemies in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Starlight, Shine Bright
skills.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful piercing attack at surrounding enemies in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Power of Teamwork
skills.description:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Launches a piercing attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Evasive Assist: Flash Spin
skills.description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Fatal Shot
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Pierces enemies in a large area in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Steady Shot
skills.description: Billy's DMG increases by 50% when he enters Crouching Shot during his Basic Attack. The effect ends if he moves, returns to standby, or is knocked back or launched by an attack.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Team Starlight
skills.description:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
After Billy uses a Chain Attack, the DMG of his next Ultimate is increased by 50%, stacking up to 2 times. This effect resets whenever an Ultimate is activated.

mindscapes.name: Dazzling Entrance
mindscapes.description: When Billy hits an enemy with a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, he gains an additional 2.7 Energy. Can trigger once every 5s.

mindscapes.name: Roaming Gunslinger
mindscapes.description: Billy's Dodge Counter DMG increases by 25%. Rolling Shots during his Basic Attacks count as dodges, making Billy Invulnerable during skill activation and able to trigger Perfect Dodges. When a Rolling Shot triggers a Perfect Dodge, it will automatically follow up with a Dodge Counter.

mindscapes.name: Teachings of the Starlight Knights
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Starlight Ballistics
mindscapes.description: When Billy hits an enemy with his EX Special Attack, the skill's CRIT Rate increases based on the distance from the enemy. The closer he is to the target, the greater the effect, up to a maximum increase of 32%.

mindscapes.name: Lost Technological Construct
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Starlight Hero
mindscapes.description: When Billy accumulates 10 hits on enemies or triggers a Perfect Dodge, his DMG increases by 6%, stacking up to 5 times and lasting until he's knocked back or launched by an attack.
